Doorway chest stretch, forearm on the frame|30 s / side|Forearm flat on the door frame, elbow at shoulder height. Step through with the same-side foot and turn your chest away. Stop at a stretch, never a pinch in the shoulder.

Standing hip flexor, hands on a counter, tailbone tucked|30 s / side|Split stance, hands on the counter, back leg straight. Squeeze that back glute and tuck your tailbone under — the tuck is the whole stretch. Don't lunge deeper to feel more.

Seated figure-4 glute stretch on a chair|30 s / side|Sit on a chair, ankle across the opposite knee. Sit tall and hinge forward from the hips. If your belly blocks the fold, skip the lean and press the raised knee down instead.

Standing hamstring, heel on a low step, hinge at the hips|30 s / side|Heel on a low step, leg straight, chest tall. Push your hips backward rather than rounding down toward the foot. A flat back with a small range beats a rounded back with a big one.
Wall calf stretch, back leg straight, heel down|30 s / side|Hands on the wall, one leg back with the knee straight and the heel pressed down. Keep that back foot pointing forward, not turned out.

Lat stretch, hands on the counter edge, chest sinking|30 s|Hands on the counter, step back until your arms are straight, then let your chest sink toward the floor between them. Keep your head between your arms.
Seated neck side-bend|20 s / side|Sit tall, hold the edge of the seat with one hand, tilt your head away from that hand. Gentle — the neck needs far less force than you think.
